title: feat(math): harden and demonstrate math rendering
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Integrate the existing math plugin into the Electron demo, improve keyboard accessibility, and add documentation and regression coverage.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

The math plugin already supported inline and block KaTeX rendering, but it was not enabled in the Electron demo and had limited automated coverage. The block edit control also relied on pointer hover and did not remain visible during keyboard focus.

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): N/A — hardening an existing plugin
- OpenSpec change: N/A — no new capability or public API

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`: N/A
- `packages/plugin-math`:
  - Keep the block edit button visible during pointer hover or keyboard focus.
  - Add unit coverage for registration, rendering, fallback behavior, editing, accessibility, and event isolation.
  - Add package installation, CSS, usage, styling, and API documentation.
  - Include the package README in published files.
- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - Register `createMathPlugin()`.
  - Import the KaTeX stylesheet and configure workspace aliases.
  - Add a sample-vault math demonstration.
  - Add an editor-shell integration test.
- `openspec/`: N/A

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — 547 tests passed
- [x] Affected packages build / 受影响包构建通过
  - `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-math build`
  - `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-electron-demo build`
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - 9 plugin-math unit tests
  - Electron editor-shell math integration test
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：
  - TODO: verify `math-demo.md` and attach a screenshot

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot
- [ ] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is **not** primarily generated by AI.
      AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明：
      Codex substantially assisted with the functional implementation, tests,
      documentation, and verification. The contributor has not yet independently
      reimplemented the functional changes.
- [x] **New dependencies**:
      - `katex@^0.16.0` — MIT — declared directly by the Electron demo because
        it imports the KaTeX stylesheet; the math plugin already uses KaTeX for rendering.
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] No public API change; package documentation was added
- [x] `live-preview-table.ts` was not touched
- [x] No new capability or breaking change; no OpenSpec proposal required
- [x] Change aligns with project scope

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes)

+# Math Rendering
+
+Back to [[index]].
+
+This note demonstrates the existing `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-math` integration
+in the Electron demo.
+
+## Inline formulas
+
+Euler's identity is $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$, and the mass-energy relation is
+$E = mc^2$. Click an inline formula to reveal its Markdown source.
+
+## Block formulas
+
+$$
+\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx = \frac{1}{3}
+$$
+
+$$
+\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
+$$
+
+Hover a block formula to reveal its edit button. The same button must become
+visible when reached with the keyboard, and activating it returns the cursor
+to the formula source.
+
+## Invalid input
+
+KaTeX errors stay inside the preview instead of breaking the editor:
+
+$\unknownCommand{$

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+# @floatboat/nexus-plugin-math
+
+KaTeX-powered inline and block math rendering for
+[Nexus-Editor](https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor).
+
+## Install
+
+```bash
+pnpm add @floatboat/nexus-core @floatboat/nexus-plugin-math katex
+```
+
+KaTeX is a runtime dependency of the plugin, but applications that import its
+stylesheet should also declare it directly. Import the stylesheet once from
+your application entry point:
+
+```ts
+import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";
+```
+
+If your host does not bundle CSS imports, serve
+`katex/dist/katex.min.css` as a regular stylesheet instead.
+
+## Usage
+
+```ts
+import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";
+
+import { createEditor } from "@floatboat/nexus-core";
+import { createMathPlugin } from "@floatboat/nexus-plugin-math";
+
+const editor = createEditor({
+  container: document.getElementById("editor")!,
+  initialValue: [
+    "Euler's identity is $e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0$.",
+    "",
+    "$$",
+    "\\int_0^1 x^2 \\, dx = \\frac{1}{3}",
+    "$$",
+  ].join("\n"),
+  livePreview: true,
+  plugins: [createMathPlugin()],
+});
+```
+
+The plugin registers `remark-math`, so both forms are parsed automatically:
+
+```markdown
+Inline: $E = mc^2$
+
+$$
+\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
+$$
+```
+
+## Editing formulas
+
+- Inline formulas return to Markdown source when the editor cursor enters
+  their source range.
+- Block formulas expose an **Edit formula** button. It appears on pointer
+  hover or keyboard focus and moves the cursor to the formula source.
+- Invalid KaTeX input is rendered as an error instead of throwing from the
+  editor render pipeline.
+
+## Styling
+
+The plugin adds these host classes in addition to KaTeX's own classes:
+
+- `.nexus-math-inline`
+- `.nexus-math-display`
+
+They can be styled from the host application. The block edit button uses the
+standard Nexus CSS variables `--nexus-bg`, `--nexus-border-subtle`, and
+`--nexus-text-muted`, with built-in fallbacks.
+
+## API
+
+### `createMathPlugin(): NexusPlugin`
+
+Creates a plugin containing the `remark-math` parser extension plus inline and
+block widget definitions. The function has no options and does not mutate
+global KaTeX configuration.
+
+## License
+
+MIT
